articles.title: 老年手术患者认知衰弱表型与术后谵妄风险：一项回顾性队列研究
articles.originalTitle: Cognitive-frailty phenotyping and postoperative delirium risk in older surgical patients: a retrospective cohort study.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Postoperative delirium remains a common complication in older surgical patients. Frailty and cognitive impairment are established risk factors but are often assessed independently. We examined whether a pragmatic 2x2 cognitive-frailty phenotype framework stratifies postoperative delirium risk. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included patients aged >/=70 yr undergoing elective noncardiac, noncranial surgery at a tertiary centre from February 2022 to July 2024. Cognition and frailty were assessed using the Mini-Cog and Clinical Frailty Scale. Patients were classified into four phenotypes: intact, frail-only, cognitive-only, and cognitive-frailty. POD was assessed using the 4A's Test (4AT) in the PACU on the day of surgery and in surgical wards on postoperative days 1 and 2. The primary outcome was overall postoperative delirium, defined as at least one positive 4AT assessment. The secondary outcome was postoperative length of stay (LOS). RESULTS: Among 3353 patients, 61% were intact, 20% frail-only, 11% cognitive-only, and 8% cognitive-frailty. Overall postoperative delirium incidence was 7.5%, increasing from 4.2% in the intact to 24.0% in the cognitive-frailty phenotype (P<0.001). Compared with intact, postoperative delirium risk was highest in the cognitive-frailty phenotype (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 4.79, 95% confidence interval [CI] 3.22-7.11), followed by the cognitive-only phenotype (aOR 2.41, 95% CI 1.60-3.63) and the frail-only phenotype (aOR 1.72, 95% CI 1.20-2.47). Median postoperative LOS increased from 2.6 to 4.5 days across phenotypes (P<0.001). CONCLUSIONS: In this cohort of older surgical patients, a pragmatic two-dimensional cognitive-frailty framework based on bedside screening tools demonstrated a clear gradient in postoperative delirium risk. This might support perioperative risk stratification, preventive strategies, and future research.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 术后谵妄仍然是老年手术患者的常见并发症。衰弱和认知障碍是公认的危险因素，但通常被独立评估。我们研究了一个实用的2x2认知-衰弱表型框架是否能对术后谵妄风险进行分层。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 这项回顾性队列研究纳入了2022年2月至2024年7月期间在三级医疗中心接受择期非心脏、非颅脑手术的年龄≥70岁的患者。使用Mini-Cog和临床衰弱量表评估认知和衰弱。患者被分为四种表型：完整、仅衰弱、仅认知障碍和认知-衰弱。术后谵妄在手术当天在麻醉后监护室（PACU）以及术后第1天和第2天在外科病房使用4A测试（4AT）进行评估。主要结局是总体术后谵妄，定义为至少一次4AT评估阳性。次要结局是术后住院时间（LOS）。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在3353名患者中，61%为完整，20%为仅衰弱，11%为仅认知障碍，8%为认知-衰弱。总体术后谵妄发生率为7.5%，从完整表型的4.2%增加到认知-衰弱表型的24.0%（P<0.001）。与完整相比，术后谵妄风险在认知-衰弱表型中最高（调整后比值比[aOR] 4.79，95%置信区间[CI] 3.22-7.11），其次是仅认知障碍表型（aOR 2.41，95% CI 1.60-3.63）和仅衰弱表型（aOR 1.72，95% CI 1.20-2.47）。术后中位住院时间从2.6天增加到4.5天（P<0.001）。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 在这组老年手术患者中，基于床旁筛查工具的实用二维认知-衰弱框架显示了术后谵妄风险的明显梯度。这可能支持围手术期风险分层、预防策略和未来研究。

articles.title: 术后谵妄前后定量脑电图变化：一项前瞻性多中心队列研究
articles.originalTitle: Quantitative Electroencephalogram Changes before and after Postoperative Delirium: A Prospective, Multicenter Cohort Study.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Delirium occurs frequently after major surgery in older adults and is associated with long-term cognitive dysfunction. While postoperative delirium (POD) shows electroencephalographic (EEG) changes during the acute phase, it remains unclear whether quantitative EEG alterations precede or persist after POD. Identifying such patterns could reveal risk markers and mechanisms of long-term cognitive dysfunction. METHODS: In this prospective, multicenter cohort study, EEG recordings were obtained in patients aged 65 yr or older before and 3 months after major elective surgery without preexistent cognitive dysfunction, and in nonsurgical controls. The authors analyzed quantitative EEG measures that show alterations during acute delirium, namely relative power, phase-based and amplitude-based functional connectivity, spectral variability, and signal complexity. Linear mixed models were used to assess effects of time, surgery, and POD on these EEG measures. RESULTS: Of 379 enrolled surgical patients, 330 had sufficient EEG data quality, of whom 59 (18%) developed POD. Fifty-seven nonsurgical controls were included and served as a reference. At baseline, future POD patients exhibited significantly lower beta amplitude-based connectivity (beta = -0.36; Pcorrected = 0.04). No other EEG measures showed significant differences between groups at baseline. Three months after surgery, no persistent changes in quantitative EEG characteristics were observed in relation to POD occurrence or surgery alone. CONCLUSIONS: This study identified reduced preoperative beta amplitude-based connectivity as a possible marker of neurophysiological vulnerability for POD. However, the absence of significant longitudinal changes in quantitative EEG measures suggests that resting-state EEG networks may functionally recover or compensate in this cohort at 3 months postoperative.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 谵妄在老年人重大手术后经常发生，并与长期认知功能障碍相关。虽然术后谵妄（POD）在急性期表现出脑电图（EEG）改变，但尚不清楚定量EEG改变是否先于POD出现或在POD后持续存在。识别这些模式可能揭示长期认知功能障碍的风险标志物和机制。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 在这项前瞻性、多中心队列研究中，对65岁及以上、无先前认知功能障碍、接受重大择期手术的患者在术前和术后3个月进行EEG记录，并纳入非手术对照组。作者分析了在急性谵妄期间表现出改变的定量EEG指标，即相对功率、基于相位和基于振幅的功能连接、频谱变异性和信号复杂度。使用线性混合模型评估时间、手术和POD对这些EEG指标的影响。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在379名入组的手术患者中，330名具有足够的EEG数据质量，其中59名（18%）发生了POD。纳入57名非手术对照组作为参考。在基线时，未来发生POD的患者表现出显著较低的β振幅基连接（β = -0.36；P校正 = 0.04）。其他EEG指标在基线时组间无显著差异。术后3个月，未观察到与POD发生或仅手术相关的定量EEG特征的持续变化。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 本研究确定术前β振幅基连接降低可能是POD的神经生理脆弱性的可能标志物。然而，定量EEG指标缺乏显著的纵向变化表明，在术后3个月，静息态EEG网络可能在该队列中功能恢复或代偿。

articles.title: 儿童围手术期体验评估工具EVANpedia的开发与验证
articles.originalTitle: Development and Validation of EVANpedia for the Assessment of Perioperative Experience in Pediatric Patients.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Patient-reported outcome and experience measures are essential for advancing pediatric patient-centered care in the perioperative context. Combining complementary patient-centered instruments supports a broader, multidimensional evaluation of perioperative care. The Pediatric Scale for Quality of Recovery is a patient-reported outcome measure assessing quality of recovery after surgery and anesthesia in children and represents an important step in this field. This study aimed to develop and validate a self-reported instrument, the Evaluation du Vecu de l'Anesthesie Generale en Pediatrie (EVANpedia), designed to assess experience in children and adolescents within 24 h after surgery. METHODS: The study included a developmental phase to generate items and a psychometric validation phase. The multidimensional structure of EVANpedia was explored using factor analysis, item internal consistency, and discriminant analyses. The Rasch model assessed the unidimensionality of each dimension, and reliability was evaluated using McDonald's omega coefficient. Convergent and external validity were examined using concurrent self-report instruments and clinical data. RESULTS: Six hundred patients (7 to 17 yr old) were included across four anesthesia departments. After the development and validation phases, EVANpedia comprised 26 items grouped into 6 dimensions: anxiety, thirst and hunger, loss of autonomy, pain, nausea and vomiting, and confusion. Internal construct validity was high, with excellent fit statistics across all dimensions (from 0.95 to 1.03). Correlations between EVANpedia scores and all concurrent measures supported convergent validity. Nine percent of children reported disappointment with their perioperative experience, showing significantly lower overall EVANpedia scores (50.1 +/- 12.1 vs . 62.8 +/- 15.1; P < 0.001). Overall and all dimensional EVANpedia scores demonstrated excellent sensitivity to clinical change, supporting the responsiveness of the instrument. CONCLUSIONS: EVANpedia is a psychometrically robust self-reported instrument for assessing the perioperative experience in children and adolescents.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 患者报告的结局和体验测量对于推进围手术期背景下以儿童为中心的护理至关重要。结合互补的以患者为中心的工具有助于对围手术期护理进行更广泛、多维度的评估。儿科恢复质量量表是一种患者报告的结局测量工具，用于评估儿童手术和麻醉后的恢复质量，是该领域的重要一步。本研究旨在开发和验证一种自我报告工具——儿科全身麻醉体验评估（EVANpedia），用于评估儿童和青少年术后24小时内的体验。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 研究包括生成条目的开发阶段和心理测量验证阶段。通过因子分析、条目内部一致性和判别分析探讨了EVANpedia的多维结构。Rasch模型评估了每个维度的单维性，并使用McDonald's omega系数评估信度。使用同时进行的自我报告工具和临床数据检验了聚合效度和外部效度。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 四个麻醉科室共纳入600名患者（7至17岁）。经过开发和验证阶段，EVANpedia包含26个条目，分为6个维度：焦虑、口渴和饥饿、自主性丧失、疼痛、恶心和呕吐以及困惑。内部结构效度较高，所有维度的拟合统计量均良好（从0.95到1.03）。EVANpedia评分与所有同时进行的测量之间的相关性支持了聚合效度。9%的儿童报告对其围手术期体验感到失望，其EVANpedia总分显著较低（50.1 +/- 12.1 vs . 62.8 +/- 15.1；P < 0.001）。总体和所有维度的EVANpedia评分均表现出对临床变化的极佳敏感性，支持了该工具的反应性。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: EVANpedia是一种心理测量学上稳健的自我报告工具，用于评估儿童和青少年的围手术期体验。

articles.title: 椎管内麻醉下剖宫产术中疼痛的发生率：一项国际前瞻性队列研究
articles.originalTitle: Incidence of Pain during Cesarean Delivery with Neuraxial Anesthesia: An International, Prospective Cohort Study.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Neuraxial anesthesia techniques are considered the preferred techniques for cesarean delivery; however, the true incidence of pain during cesarean delivery with neuraxial anesthesia is not currently known. To date, studies have been retrospective or conducted in a single center. The primary aim of this international cohort study was to prospectively determine the incidence of patient-reported pain during cesarean delivery with neuraxial anesthesia. METHODS: Over 8 weeks, a multicenter cohort study was conducted in 15 centers across the United States and Canada. All patients who underwent cesarean delivery with neuraxial anesthesia were surveyed on postpartum day 1 regarding the presence of intraoperative pain and were asked to grade their pain using a numeric rating score (0 to 10) and rate their satisfaction (yes or no) with their pain management. RESULTS: A total of 3,693 patients were included in the analysis. An overall incidence of patient-reported pain during cesarean delivery was 7.6% (95% confidence interval [CI], 6.8 to 8.5%) with 282 of 3,693 patients reporting pain. In patients undergoing elective cesarean delivery, intraoperative pain was reported in 3.7% (95% CI, 2.7 to 5.0%) with spinal, 9.2% (95% CI, 6.7 to 12.2%) with combined spinal-epidural, and 12.2% (95% CI, 4.1 to 26.2%) with epidural top-up anesthesia. In the non-elective setting, pain was more commonly reported by patients: 5.7% (95% CI, 4.0 to 7.8%) with spinal, 7.1% (95% CI, 4.7 to 10.1%) with combined spinal-epidural, 8.0% (95% CI, 2.2 to 19.2%) with dural puncture epidural, and 13.2% (95% CI, 11.1 to 15.5%) with epidural top-up anesthesia. Patients who had intraoperative pain reported a median (interquartile range) numeric rating score of 6 (4 to 8) out of 10. In those who reported pain, dissatisfaction with how the pain was managed by the anesthesia team was reported by 29 (10.3%) patients. CONCLUSIONS: The overall incidence of patient-reported pain during cesarean delivery with neuraxial anesthesia in this multicenter cohort was 7.6%. This varied significantly by anesthesia technique, with spinal having the lowest incidence and epidural top-up having the highest. Further work is required to characterize the pain experience, understand its impact, and develop techniques to reduce its incidence.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 椎管内麻醉技术被认为是剖宫产的首选技术；然而，目前尚不清楚椎管内麻醉下剖宫产术中疼痛的真实发生率。迄今为止，研究多为回顾性或在单中心进行。这项国际队列研究的主要目的是前瞻性地确定椎管内麻醉下剖宫产术中患者报告疼痛的发生率。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 在8周内，在美国和加拿大的15个中心进行了一项多中心队列研究。所有接受椎管内麻醉下剖宫产的患者在产后第1天接受调查，询问是否存在术中疼痛，并要求使用数字评分（0至10分）对疼痛进行分级，并对其疼痛管理满意度进行评分（是或否）。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 共有3693名患者纳入分析。剖宫产术中患者报告疼痛的总体发生率为7.6%（95%置信区间[CI]，6.8%至8.5%），其中3693名患者中有282名报告疼痛。在接受择期剖宫产的患者中，术中疼痛报告率在脊髓麻醉为3.7%（95% CI，2.7%至5.0%），在腰硬联合麻醉为9.2%（95% CI，6.7%至12.2%），在硬膜外追加麻醉为12.2%（95% CI，4.1%至26.2%）。在非择期情况下，患者报告疼痛更为常见：脊髓麻醉为5.7%（95% CI，4.0%至7.8%），腰硬联合麻醉为7.1%（95% CI，4.7%至10.1%），硬脊膜穿破硬膜外麻醉为8.0%（95% CI，2.2%至19.2%），硬膜外追加麻醉为13.2%（95% CI，11.1%至15.5%）。有术中疼痛的患者报告的中位数（四分位距）数字评分为6（4至8）分（满分10分）。在报告疼痛的患者中，有29名（10.3%）患者对麻醉团队的疼痛管理方式不满意。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 在这项多中心队列中，椎管内麻醉下剖宫产术中患者报告疼痛的总体发生率为7.6%。这一发生率因麻醉技术而异，脊髓麻醉的发生率最低，硬膜外追加麻醉的发生率最高。需要进一步的工作来描述疼痛体验，了解其影响，并开发技术以降低其发生率。

articles.title: 单次静脉推注丙泊酚对慢性不可预见性轻度应激小鼠模型抑郁样行为的影响
articles.originalTitle: Effects of Single Bolus Exposure to Propofol on Depression-like Behavior in a Chronic Unpredictable Mild Stress Model in Mice.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Depression is a prevalent psychiatric disorder linked to excitatory/inhibitory neurotransmission imbalance, particularly in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC). Propofol, a gamma-aminobutyric acid type A (GABA A ) receptor agonist, induces rapid mood improvements clinically, yet its antidepressant-like effects and underlying mechanisms remain unclear. METHODS: Network pharmacology was used to identify propofol-related targets linked to excitatory/inhibitory balance. Male mice exposed to chronic unpredictable mild stress (CUMS) received a single intraperitoneal injection of propofol. Depressive-like behaviors were assessed using the open field, tail suspension, and forced swim tests. gamma-Aminobutyric acid-mediated (GABAergic) and glutamatergic signaling in the mPFC was evaluated by Western blotting, immunofluorescence, and fiber photometry calcium imaging. Optogenetic manipulation of mPFC GABAergic interneurons was performed to test their causal involvement. RESULTS: In both male and female mice, compared with the control group, propofol (50 mg . kg -1 ) significantly reduced CUMS-induced depression-like behaviors, showing optimal efficacy in the open field test, tail suspension test, forced swim test, and sucrose preference test. Propofol increased mPFC GABAergic neuron excitability while suppressing glutamatergic activity. It also restored CUMS-induced reductions in GABAergic (glutamate decarboxylase [GAD] 65, GAD67, vesicular GABA transporter [VGAT], GABA transporter 3 [GAT3], gamma-aminobutyric acid type A receptor subunit alpha 1 [GABA A alpha1], gamma-aminobutyric acid type A receptor subunit gamma 2 [GABA A gamma2]) and glutamatergic (glutamate ionotropic receptor AMPA type subunit 1 [GluA1], metabotropic glutamate receptor 5 [mGlu5], vesicular glutamate transporter 1 [VGLUT1]) protein expression. Pharmacologic inhibition of GABA A receptors with the antagonist bicuculline abolished propofol's antidepressant effects. Optogenetic activation of GABAergic interneurons at 10 Hz enhanced propofol's antidepressant effects, whereas inhibition attenuated them. CONCLUSIONS: Propofol produces rapid antidepressant-like effects through activating the GABA A receptors and restoring the gamma-aminobutyric acid/glutamate balance. These findings suggest that propofol could be a useful tool for investigating the mechanisms of fast-acting antidepressant.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 抑郁症是一种常见的精神疾病，与兴奋性/抑制性神经传递失衡有关，尤其是在内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）中。丙泊酚是一种γ-氨基丁酸A型（GABA A）受体激动剂，在临床上可快速改善情绪，但其抗抑郁样效应及潜在机制仍不清楚。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 采用网络药理学方法鉴定与兴奋性/抑制性平衡相关的丙泊酚靶点。暴露于慢性不可预见性轻度应激（CUMS）的雄性小鼠接受单次腹腔注射丙泊酚。通过旷场实验、悬尾实验和强迫游泳实验评估抑郁样行为。通过Western blotting、免疫荧光和纤维光度钙成像评估mPFC中γ-氨基丁酸能（GABAergic）和谷氨酸能信号传导。对mPFC GABA能中间神经元进行光遗传学操作以测试其因果参与。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在雄性和雌性小鼠中，与对照组相比，丙泊酚（50 mg·kg⁻¹）显著减少了CUMS诱导的抑郁样行为，在旷场实验、悬尾实验、强迫游泳实验和糖水偏好实验中显示出最佳疗效。丙泊酚增加了mPFC GABA能神经元的兴奋性，同时抑制了谷氨酸能活性。它还恢复了CUMS诱导的GABA能（谷氨酸脱羧酶[GAD]65、GAD67、囊泡GABA转运体[VGAT]、GABA转运体3[GAT3]、GABA A受体α1亚基[GABA A α1]、GABA A受体γ2亚基[GABA A γ2]）和谷氨酸能（谷氨酸离子型受体AMPA型亚基1[GluA1]、代谢型谷氨酸受体5[mGlu5]、囊泡谷氨酸转运体1[VGLUT1]）蛋白表达的降低。用拮抗剂荷包牡丹碱药理学抑制GABA A受体可消除丙泊酚的抗抑郁作用。以10 Hz光遗传学激活GABA能中间神经元增强了丙泊酚的抗抑郁作用，而抑制则减弱了其作用。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 丙泊酚通过激活GABA A受体并恢复γ-氨基丁酸/谷氨酸平衡产生快速抗抑郁样效应。这些发现表明，丙泊酚可能是研究速效抗抑郁药机制的有用工具。

articles.methods: 抑郁症与内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）兴奋性/抑制性神经传递失衡有关。丙泊酚是GABA_A受体激动剂，临床观察显示其可快速改善情绪，但其抗抑郁样效应及机制尚不清楚。本研究利用网络药理学、慢性不可预见性轻度应激（CUMS）小鼠模型及多种神经科学手段，探讨单次丙泊酚暴露的抗抑郁样作用及潜在机制。
articles.results: 在156只雄性及44只雌性C57BL/6J小鼠中，与对照组相比，丙泊酚（50 mg/kg）显著减少CUMS诱导的抑郁样行为，在旷场实验、悬尾实验、强迫游泳实验和糖水偏好实验中均显示最佳效果（P值范围：P<0.0001至P=0.0491）。丙泊酚增加mPFC GABA能神经元兴奋性，同时抑制谷氨酸能活性，并恢复CUMS诱导的GABA能（GAD65、GAD67、VGAT、GAT3、GABA_A α1、GABA_A γ2）和谷氨酸能（GluA1、mGlu5、VGLUT1）蛋白表达下降。药理学抑制GABA_A受体（荷包牡丹碱）可消除丙泊酚的抗抑郁效应。光遗传学激活GABA能中间神经元（10 Hz）增强丙泊酚的抗抑郁效应，而抑制则减弱之。当前可获取内容未提供效应量及95%置信区间。
